summary: Stevanato Group S.p.A. filed a Form 6-K with a conference call transcript for its half-year 2026 results, disclosing completion of the divestiture of its California-based subsidiary Balda C. Brewer, a contract manufacturing business for consumables and point-of-care diagnostics. This sale aligns with the company's strategy to focus on complex, integrated drug delivery systems. No financial terms were disclosed. The registrant is the seller of the subsidiary, and the transaction was completed as of the filing date. The move follows the company's intent to optimize its footprint and shift toward higher-value solutions in the biopharmaceutical and diagnostics segments.
